item.title: Week of September 12, 2026
item.description:
Welcome to Family Dinner Plan for the week of September 12, 2026. Let’s get those plates ready.
Sunday, we’re firing up the Traeger for a Traeger Herb-Rubbed Pork Tenderloin with Roasted Brussels Sprouts & Apples. Tip: For extra caramelization on the sprouts, toss them in a little maple syrup before roasting alongside the apples.
Monday, set your slow cooker for Creamy Chicken & Cauliflower Rice Soup. Tip: Stir the cauliflower rice in during the last 30 minutes of cooking so it doesn’t get mushy.
Tuesday, it’s Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry with Zucchini Noodles. Tip: To keep the beef tender, slice it against the grain and coat it in a teaspoon of cornstarch before stir-frying.
Wednesday, warm up with Sausage, White Bean & Kale Soup. Tip: Remove the kale stems and add the leaves in the last 5 minutes of simmering so they stay bright and tender.
Thursday, another slow cooker win: Slow Cooker Honey Sesame Chicken with Cauliflower Rice. Tip: Reserve the honey and sesame seeds until the end; stir them in just before serving for that sticky-sweet glaze.
Friday, we pull a clever leftover remix: Honey Sesame Chicken Chopped Salad. Tip: Tear up the leftover chicken and toss with mixed greens, shredded carrots, sliced almonds, and a splash of rice vinegar for a fresh crunch.
And remember, Saturday is takeout night. Give yourselves a break. That’s our week, friends. Happy cooking and happy eating.
